```{r imports, echo=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(Signac) #for the analysis of single-cell chromatin datasets
library(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86) #for a set of annotations for hg38
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(GenomeInfoDb)
```

## data import


```{r data import, echo = FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

Multiome_path <- "/data-pure/sequencing/ngs/NGS2026_10893/HG38/count/cellranger/GG001AC/filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"
ATAC_fragments_info_path <- "/data-pure/sequencing/ngs/NGS2026_10893/HG38/count/cellranger/GG001AC/atac_fragments.tsv.gz"
ATAC_fragments_index_path <- "/data-pure/sequencing/ngs/NGS2026_10893/HG38/count/cellranger/GG001AC/atac_fragments.tsv.gz.tbi"

inputdata.10x <- Read10X_h5(Multiome_path)
# create a gene activity matrix from the peak matrix and GTF, using chromosomes 1:22, X, and Y.
# extract RNA and ATAC data
rna_counts <- inputdata.10x$`Gene Expression`
atac_counts <- inputdata.10x$Peaks

# Create Seurat object
ATAC_gang <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = rna_counts)
ATAC_gang[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(ATAC_gang, pattern = "^MT-")

# Now add in the ATAC-seq data
# we'll only use peaks in standard chromosomes
grange.counts <- StringToGRanges(rownames(atac_counts), sep = c(":", "-"))
grange.use <- seqnames(grange.counts) %in% standardChromosomes(grange.counts)
atac_counts <- atac_counts[as.vector(grange.use), ]
annotations <- GetGRangesFromEnsDb(ensdb = EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86)
seqlevelsStyle(annotations) <- 'UCSC'
genome(annotations) <- "hg38"

frag.file <- ATAC_fragments_info_path
chrom_assay <- CreateChromatinAssay(
   counts = atac_counts,
   sep = c(":", "-"),
   genome = 'hg38',
   fragments = frag.file,
   min.cells = 10,
   annotation = annotations
 )
ATAC_gang[["ATAC"]] <- chrom_assay

# Compute ATAC QC metrics
DefaultAssay(ATAC_gang) <- "ATAC"
ATAC_gang <- NucleosomeSignal(object = ATAC_gang)
ATAC_gang <- TSSEnrichment(object = ATAC_gang, fast = FALSE)

# Compute additional single-cell ATAC noise metrics (ENCODE / Signac best practices)
# 1. Total fragments & Fraction of reads in peaks (pct_reads_in_peaks / FRiP)
total_fragments <- CountFragments(frag.file)
rownames(total_fragments) <- total_fragments$CB
ATAC_gang$fragments <- total_fragments[colnames(ATAC_gang), "frequency_count"]
ATAC_gang$pct_reads_in_peaks <- (ATAC_gang$nCount_ATAC / ATAC_gang$fragments) * 100

# 2. Blacklist ratio (fraction of fragments in ENCODE blacklisted regions)
ATAC_gang$blacklist_ratio <- FractionCountsInRegion(
  object = ATAC_gang,
  assay = "ATAC",
  regions = blacklist_hg38_unified
)
```

## TSS Enrichment Exploration (Brain Tumor & Interface Tissue)

```{r tss_distribution_analysis, echo=FALSE}
# Plot TSS enrichment distribution to assess threshold stringency (2 vs 3 vs 4)
# In brain tumor and interface samples, higher background and variable chromatin accessibility are expected.
dir.create("outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)

p_tss_dens <- ggplot(ATAC_gang@meta.data, aes(x = TSS.enrichment)) +
  geom_density(fill = "#4285F4", alpha = 0.35, color = "#1a73e8", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(2, 3, 4), linetype = "dashed", color = c("firebrick", "darkorange", "forestgreen"), linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = Inf, label = "Min Pass (2)", vjust = 2, color = "firebrick", angle = 90, size = 3.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 3, y = Inf, label = "Intermediate (3)", vjust = 2, color = "darkorange", angle = 90, size = 3.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 4, y = Inf, label = "Ideal (4)", vjust = 2, color = "forestgreen", angle = 90, size = 3.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "TSS Enrichment Score Distribution",
    subtitle = paste0("Total cells: ", ncol(ATAC_gang), 
                      " | >2: ", sum(ATAC_gang$TSS.enrichment > 2, na.rm = TRUE),
                      " | >3: ", sum(ATAC_gang$TSS.enrichment > 3, na.rm = TRUE),
                      " | >4: ", sum(ATAC_gang$TSS.enrichment > 4, na.rm = TRUE)),
    x = "TSS Enrichment Score",
    y = "Density"
  )

p_tss_scatter <- ggplot(ATAC_gang@meta.data, aes(x = nCount_ATAC, y = TSS.enrichment)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 0.8, color = "#1a73e8") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(2, 3, 4), linetype = "dashed", color = c("firebrick", "darkorange", "forestgreen"), linewidth = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "TSS Enrichment vs Sequencing Depth", x = "nCount_ATAC (log10)", y = "TSS Enrichment")

tss_combined <- p_tss_dens + p_tss_scatter
pdf("outputs/TSS_enrichment_distribution.pdf", width = 12, height = 5)
print(tss_combined)
dev.off()

tss_combined
```

## QC Violin Plots

```{r qc_violins, echo=FALSE}
VlnPlot(
  ATAC_gang,
  features = c("nCount_ATAC", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt", "TSS.enrichment", "nucleosome_signal", "pct_reads_in_peaks", "blacklist_ratio"),
  ncol = 4,
  log = TRUE,
  pt.size = 0
) + NoLegend()
```

```{r filter, echo=FALSE}
# Filtering using calibrated thresholds:
# nucleosome_signal < 4 (relaxed from < 2 to preserve valid nuclei with intact nucleosomal structure)
# percent.mt < 5 (strict for single-nuclei)
# blacklist_ratio < 0.05 (filters apoptotic nuclei / non-specific background)
ATAC_gang <- subset(
  x = ATAC_gang,
  subset = nCount_ATAC < 7e4 &
    nCount_ATAC > 4e3 &
    nCount_RNA < 25000 &
    nCount_RNA > 500 &
    percent.mt < 5 &
    TSS.enrichment > 2 &
    nucleosome_signal < 4 &
    blacklist_ratio < 0.05
)
```


```{r Future package Memory gestion, echo=FALSE}
# Load the future package (usually loaded with Seurat, but good to be explicit)
library(future)

# Increase max size to 4 GB (expressed in bytes: 4000 * 1024^2)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 4000 * 1024^2)
```


```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
# RNA analysis
#DefaultAssay(ATAC_gang) <- "RNA"
#ATAC_gang <- SCTransform(ATAC_gang, verbose = FALSE) %>% RunPCA() %>% RunUMAP(dims = 1:50, reduction.name = 'umap.rna', reduction.key = 'rnaUMAP_')
DefaultAssay(ATAC_gang) <- "RNA"
ATAC_gang <- NormalizeData(ATAC_gang) %>% 
  FindVariableFeatures() %>% 
  ScaleData() %>% 
  RunPCA() %>% 
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:50, reduction.name = 'umap.rna', reduction.key = 'rnaUMAP_')

# ATAC analysis
# We exclude the first dimension as this is typically correlated with sequencing depth
DefaultAssay(ATAC_gang) <- "ATAC"
ATAC_gang <- RunTFIDF(ATAC_gang)
ATAC_gang <- FindTopFeatures(ATAC_gang, min.cutoff = 'q0')
ATAC_gang <- RunSVD(ATAC_gang)
ATAC_gang <- RunUMAP(ATAC_gang, reduction = 'lsi', dims = 2:50, reduction.name = "umap.atac", reduction.key = "atacUMAP_")
```
## Combination of RNA and ATAC modalities
```{r WNN graph, echo=FALSE}

ATAC_gang <- FindMultiModalNeighbors(ATAC_gang, reduction.list = list("pca", "lsi"), dims.list = list(1:50, 2:50))
ATAC_gang <- RunUMAP(ATAC_gang, nn.name = "weighted.nn", reduction.name = "wnn.umap", reduction.key = "wnnUMAP_")
ATAC_gang <- FindClusters(ATAC_gang, graph.name = "wsnn", algorithm = 3, verbose = FALSE)
```


```{r Display graph unannotated, echo=FALSE}
dir.create("outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)

pdf("outputs/UMAP_initial_clusters.pdf", width = 15, height = 5)

combined_plot1
```

## Gene Activity Matrix & Chromatin-RNA Concordance

```{r gene_activity}
# Derive GeneActivity matrix from chromatin accessibility (gene bodies + 2kb upstream promoters)
# Enables orthogonal validation that epigenomic accessibility correlates with scType RNA cell annotations
DefaultAssay(ATAC_gang) <- "ATAC"
gene.activities <- GeneActivity(ATAC_gang)

# Add as a new assay
ATAC_gang[["ACTIVITY"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = gene.activities)

# Normalize GeneActivity assay
DefaultAssay(ATAC_gang) <- "ACTIVITY"
ATAC_gang <- NormalizeData(
  object = ATAC_gang,
  assay = "ACTIVITY",
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = median(ATAC_gang$nCount_ACTIVITY)
)

# Canonical brain & glioma markers to evaluate concordance:
# Astrocytic / Glioma: GFAP, SLC1A2
# Oligodendrocyte: MBP, MOG
# Neuronal: RBFOX3, SYP
# Glioma Stem / Progenitor: SOX2, OLIG2
# Microglia / Macrophage: AIF1
test_markers <- c("GFAP", "MBP", "RBFOX3", "SOX2", "AIF1")
available_markers <- intersect(test_markers, rownames(ATAC_gang[["ACTIVITY"]]))

if (length(available_markers) > 0) {
  DefaultAssay(ATAC_gang) <- "RNA"
  p_rna <- FeaturePlot(ATAC_gang, features = available_markers, reduction = "wnn.umap", ncol = length(available_markers))
  
  DefaultAssay(ATAC_gang) <- "ACTIVITY"
  p_act <- FeaturePlot(ATAC_gang, features = available_markers, reduction = "wnn.umap", ncol = length(available_markers))
  
  p_concordance <- p_rna / p_act
  pdf("outputs/RNA_vs_GeneActivity_concordance.pdf", width = 3.5 * length(available_markers), height = 7)
  print(p_concordance)
  dev.off()
}

# Set DefaultAssay back to RNA
DefaultAssay(ATAC_gang) <- "RNA"
```
